function.description: List one folder of the user's drive. Returns at most 200 entries, sorted by name, and says how many the folder actually holds. A file whose content has not been downloaded yet is marked, with its real size.
function.name: drive_list

path.description: A folder inside the sync profile, relative to the profile root, `/`-separated. Use "" for the profile root. Never absolute, never containing "..".

profile.description: The sync profile's id. Omit it for the profile this conversation is about.

function.description: Read one text file from the user's drive. Returns at most 65536 bytes and says so when it stopped early — ask for a line range to see more. A binary file is refused rather than returned as unreadable characters, and a file whose content has not been downloaded yet reports its real size instead of its placeholder. A note also reports its OKF type and who reviewed it.
function.name: drive_read

line_count.description: How many lines to return. Omit for as many as the byte limit allows.

path.description: A file inside the sync profile, relative to the profile root, `/`-separated. Never absolute, never containing "..".

profile.description: The sync profile's id. Omit it for the profile this conversation is about.

start_line.description: First line to return, 1-based. Omit for the start of the file.

function.description: Find files under a folder whose path matches a glob pattern (`*`, `**`, `?`, `[a-z]`; `*` does not cross a folder boundary). Returns at most 100 paths.
function.name: drive_glob

path.description: A folder inside the sync profile, relative to the profile root, `/`-separated. Use "" for the profile root. Never absolute, never containing "..".

pattern.description: The glob, relative to `path`. For example `**/*.md`.

profile.description: The sync profile's id. Omit it for the profile this conversation is about.

function.description: Search file contents under a folder for a LITERAL string — not a regular expression. Returns at most 100 matching lines, each clipped to 400 bytes, and reports how many files it could not read.
function.name: drive_grep

case_sensitive.description: Whether case matters. Defaults to false.

needle.description: The exact text to look for. Not a pattern.

path.description: A folder inside the sync profile, relative to the profile root, `/`-separated. Use "" for the profile root. Never absolute, never containing "..".

profile.description: The sync profile's id. Omit it for the profile this conversation is about.

function.description: Report one path's kind, size and last modification without reading it. Use it before reading something that may be large.
function.name: drive_stat
